terra.problem: “To him they were just two more folks walking in” states the man’s perspective as fact, though the text does not give it.
The text does not say the man had no idea what was coming.
“Wrong ancestor” uses “wrong” about the baker’s answer.
“No wobbly practice laps either” asserts a detail the text does not give.
The text does not say whether the man needed to wash anything.
The text does not say he walked through the same gate where he had begged.
Praising God is not described as his first move. He sprang to his feet and began to walk.
The text says the man praised God, but does not describe a happy noise.
The text does not say the people walked past him every day or that he leaped past them.
The coffee comparison mentions a food or drink outside the permitted exceptions.
The passage calls Solomon’s Colonnade a walkway; it does not describe it as a big covered hallway.
The statement that Solomon was David’s son is a fact from outside the passage and needs its own reference.
“He saw it” implies Peter saw the resurrection happen. Peter says he and the others are witnesses that God raised Jesus, but does not say they saw the event itself.
Peter later speaks of all the families of the earth, not nations.
